surface_name: Google Email app, Search emails module
title: Gmail search module returns emails with empty bodies
symptoms: Body is empty in every bundle
Only subject and snippet are filled
cause: The module's format parameter defaults to a metadata-only mode that returns no body. The module also has no text field; with format set to full the body arrives in fullTextBody and htmlBody.
fix: Set format to full, turn on the HTML body option, and map fullTextBody or htmlBody.
apply: google-email:executeEmailSearchQuery: format = full, includeHtmlBody = true; map {{1.fullTextBody}}
affected: Make Google Email app version 4, July 2026
